title: Beyond Hormuz: Africa’s Refining Revival
gist: Oxford Economics webinar teaser: the Strait of Hormuz closure highlights Africa's dependence on imported fuel and is spurring new and revived refineries.

insights.claim: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has underscored the paradox that Africa produces oil but many of its economies depend heavily on imported fuel.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Fuel import dependence is a macro vulnerability for African economies during Gulf disruption.

insights.claim: New African refineries are in the pipeline and dormant capacity is being revived as the continent looks to process its own crude.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Possible refining capex theme for African oil-producing markets.
